# ⚡ ComponentX · Catalog

The complete ComponentX library — **417 components** across **14 semantic families** plus **23 design themes**, every entry a deep link to its full file.

## How to use this catalog

**Do not scan the whole library.** Classify the request, open the matching type folder, search filenames and tags, then read only the best 1–3 component files.

```text
components/
  ├── 3d             25 components → 3D, WebGL, and shader effects
  ├── animation      32 components → motion, hover, and scroll effects
  ├── background     24 components → gradients, beams, particles, and backdrops
  ├── button         76 components → buttons, badges, and action triggers
  ├── card           16 components → cards and content containers
  ├── data-display   17 components → tables, calendars, charts, and progress
  ├── feedback        4 components → alerts, toasts, and validation states
  ├── form          135 components → inputs, fields, and complete forms
  ├── layout          7 components → grids, spacing, and page structure
  ├── loader          7 components → spinners, skeletons, and loading states
  ├── media          13 components → carousels, galleries, and media players
  ├── navigation     35 components → navbars, menus, sidebars, and tabs
  ├── overlay        10 components → modals, dialogs, popovers, and tooltips
  ├── text           16 components → typography, text effects, and editors
Designs/
  └──  23 themes → premium UI style references
```

### One-line install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/naaafizz/ComponentX/main/install.sh | bash   # macOS / Linux
# PowerShell: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/naaafizz/ComponentX/main/install.ps1 | iex
# keep it fresh:  componentx update
```

Every file carries `library: "ComponentX"` frontmatter and one of four quality tiers: `lightweight` · `standard` · `advanced` · `showcase`.

## Recommended agent flow

1. **Classify** — identify the component type.
2. **Search** — filter that folder by filename/tags.
3. **Shortlist** — pick 1–3 candidates.
4. **Read** — open only those files.
5. **Adapt** — check quality, dependencies, and implementation details, then implement.

## Naming

Filenames are normalized and carry no source-library branding suffixes. Numeric suffixes (`-2`, `-3`) exist only for normalized-name collisions.

### Theme routing

1. Match the requested brand or mood to a theme file name.
2. Open only that file.
3. Port the CSS tokens (colors, type, spacing, radius, shadows) into the host project's design system.
